title: Reverse Transcription and qRT-PCR Protocol
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rtcd6iw
materials: For RNA extraction, 6 female third instar wandering larvae were homogenised in TRI reagent (Sigma) in a Precellys 24 homogeniser (Bertin Technologies, île-de-France, France).
1.5 µg of total RNA was treated with DNase I Amplification Grade (Sigma).

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Extract RNA using the standard TRI reagent protocol.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Prepare cDNA using a ProtoScript cDNA synthesis kit (New England Biolabs, MA, USA).

substeps.instruction: Use 1.5 µg RNA template in a 20 µl reaction mixture.

steps.title: Select Primers for Quantification
steps.instruction: Use the following primers for the quantification of mtDNA and nuclear genes:

substeps.instruction: mtDNA genes: ATP6 (F: 5’-AGAATAGCGGGTGTTCCTTGA-3’, R: 3’-CCATCAGGTCATAATGGATCT-5’), ND4 (F: 5’-AACTGGAGCTTCAACATGAGC-3’, R: 3’-AGCCAGAACGTTTACAAGCTG-5’), ND6 (F: 5’-AATTCATCCATTAGCTTTAGG-3’, R: 3’-AGAGGCTAAAGATGTTACGTA-5’), 12srRNA (F: 5’-TGGCGGTATTTTAGTCTATCT-3’, R: 3’-AAGCTACACCTTGATCTGATA-5’), lrRNA (F: 5’-AGTCTAACCTGCCCACTGAAA-3’, R: 3’-AGGGTCTTCTCGTCTTTTAAA-5’)

Nuclear genes: GSTE1 (F: 5’- TCTTCTTCGATGCCAGTGTAATC-3’, R: 3’-CACTGGCATCGAAGAAGAGAC-5’), GstE5 (F: 5’- GGTAACTACATTTGGGACTCGC-3’, R: 3’- ATCTCTGGGATACAGGGCATC-5’), Notch (F: 5’-GTCGGCGACTACTGTGAACAC-3’, R: 3’-GTTGCGAAAGGTCACCTGACA-5’), CrebB (F: 5’-ATGGACAACAGCATCGTCGA-3’, R: 3’-ACGACATCGACCACGTCATT-5’), eloF (F: 5’-GCACATTGATTGGCTATCTGCT-3’, R: 3’- GATTTGGTAGGCTTTCAGGACA-5’), bmm (F: 5’-AAGTATGCACCGCATCTGTTG-3’, R: 3’-CAAATCGCAGAGGAGACAGC-5’), Ilp2 (F: 5’-ATGAGCAAGCCTTTGTCCTTC-3’, R: 3’-ACCTCGTTGAGCTTTTCACTG-5’), ERR (F: 5’-GACCTCTCTATCCTGCGATTTG-3’, R: 3’-CCACTTGTACCACTTCCTTTCAG-5’), Zw (F: 5’- TTTGACGGCAAGATTCCGCA-3’, R: 3’- CACCAGAGCGTGGGGTAGA-5’), Inr (F: 5’-AAGCGTGGGAAAATTAAGATGGA-3’, R: 3’- GGCTGTCAACTGCTTCTACTG-5’)

steps.title: Run qRT-PCR Program
steps.instruction: Perform the qRT-PCR amplification using the following thermal cycling conditions:

substeps.instruction: Perform 40 cycles of: 95° C for 10 s, followed by 60° C for 30 s.

steps.title: Perform Melting Curve Analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct a melting curve analysis to verify the amplification of a single product.

substeps.instruction: Increase temperature from 72° C to 95° C in steps of 0.5° C.

steps.title: Analyze Expression Levels
steps.instruction: Analyze the qPCR studies using the comparative cycle threshold (Ct) method.

substeps.instruction: Express mRNA levels as the relative fold change against normalized rp49 and Actin88 mRNA.
